claim: We also show that short-term return reversal is driven by temporary liquidity imbalances lasting less than an hour and bid-ask bounce.
quote: We also show that short-term return reversal is driven by temporary liquidity imbalances lasting less than an hour and bid-ask bounce.
limitations: arXiv abstract page snapshot (tag-stripped text), not full paper; TAQ sample ends 2003, pre-decimal-penny and pre-Reg-NMS-era microstructure.
independent_replication: Short-term reversal as liquidity-provision compensation is corroborated by Kang, Lin, Xiong (JEDC 2022) and the intraday-loser buying pressure in Baltussen, Da, Soebhag (2025); not re-derived locally.
impact_on_spec: Motivates the router's opening-reversal selection and warns the edge is a liquidity-provision premium that is large in wide-spread illiquid tapes (IEX-only prints) and small at SIP quotes.

claim: Individual stocks experience sharp intraday return reversals in the cross-section during the last 30 minutes of the trading day.
quote: Individual stocks experience sharp intraday return reversals in the cross-section during the last 30 minutes of the trading day.
limitations: Working paper (April 2025); documents reversal in the last 30 minutes, not the first minutes after the open; effect attributed to retail attention and short-seller risk management.
independent_replication: Single working paper; the intraday reversal literature (Heston et al. 2010; Kang et al. 2022) is consistent but covers different windows.
impact_on_spec: Supports the sign of the route's exposure (long intraday losers) while showing the payoff is concentrated late in the day, not at the 09:32 entry.

claim: Eleven families fail because gross return before friction is 0.07-1.50 points, below the 2.0-point friction floor.
quote: Eleven families fail because gross return before friction is 0.07-1.50 points, below the 2.0-point friction floor.
limitations: Futures, not single stocks; single-author arXiv preprint (v3 2026-09-15); OHLCV signals only. Its gap-continuation short and VVG reversal both failed year stability.
independent_replication: Independent negative evidence that most OHLCV-only intraday rules do not survive friction and year-stability; no replication found yet.
impact_on_spec: Sets the bar for the router recheck: net-of-cost, out-of-window, year-stable, placebo-beating; it is the direct counter-prior for the IEX-derived research_pass.

claim: Previous studies of the U.S. market regard short-term reversal as compensation for liquidity provision.
quote: Previous studies of the U.S. market regard short-term reversal as compensation for liquidity provision.
limitations: Chinese-market evidence; abstract-level snapshot; proposes liquidity oversupply by uninformed providers, not a U.S. result.
independent_replication: Consistent with Heston et al. (2010) for the U.S. liquidity-provision reading; the Chinese-market mechanism differs.
impact_on_spec: Reversal returns are tied to liquidity provision, so they depend on how prints and fills are measured (IEX-only vs consolidated tape).

claim: we dissect their returns into intraday and overnight com- ponents with respect to the U.S. market hours
quote: we dissect their returns into intraday and overnight com- ponents with respect to the U.S. market hours
limitations: ADR pairs setting, not a single-stock reversal test; used only for the overnight/intraday return decomposition convention.
impact_on_spec: Same-day flatten means the router earns no overnight return; its series must be compared with S3 on a same-session close-to-close convention.

claim: accounts for approximately ~2.5% of the market volume

limitations: Vendor documentation snapshot (tag-stripped); the 2.5% figure is a vendor estimate that varies over time.

claim: split : adjust price and volume for forward and reverse stock splits dividend : adjust price for cash dividends spin-off : adjust price for spin-offs all : apply all above adjustments
quote: split : adjust price and volume for forward and reverse stock splits dividend : adjust price for cash dividends spin-off : adjust price for spin-offs all : apply all above adjustments
limitations: Documents the API parameter only; which adjustment the local SIP archive used is verified separately against data/sip/daily in this iteration.

impact_on_spec: Adjusted-for-dividends prices change lookback returns by the dividend yield at most; splits must be adjusted or lookback returns break.
